response.sql: SELECT AVG(media_type_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(Track.Bytes AS FLOAT) / Track.Milliseconds) as media_type_avg FROM Track WHERE Track.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY Track.MediaTypeId) AS subquery

assumptions.assumption: The phrase 'pass a file-size cutoff of 10,323,804 bytes' is interpreted as Bytes >= 10,323,804 (inclusive boundary); a track with exactly 10,323,804 bytes is included

alternatives.interpretation: If 'pass a file-size cutoff of 10,323,804 bytes' means Bytes > 10,323,804 (strictly greater, exclusive boundary)
